query: TSMC smartphone platform revenue Apple iPhone chips
normalized: apple chips iphone platform revenue smartphone tsmc

output.content:
**TSMC does not disclose revenue from Apple or iPhone chips as a separate line item**, so an exact “Apple iPhone-chip revenue” figure cannot be derived from its public reporting. [[1]] 

For the latest completed fiscal year, **2025**, TSMC reported **NT$3.809 trillion (US$122.42 billion)** of revenue, of which the **smartphone platform represented 29%**, or approximately **NT$1.105 trillion (US$35.5 billion)**. [[2]] [[3]] 

Apple’s A-series application processors for iPhones are an important part of that smartphone-platform revenue, but the platform also includes chips made for other handset customers; conversely, Apple’s TSMC purchases also include non-iPhone silicon such as Mac processors, which need not fall within the smartphone platform. [[1]] 

TSMC’s 2025 filing says its **largest customer accounted for 19% of company revenue**, implying roughly **NT$724 billion (US$23.3 billion)**, but it does **not name that customer** in the filing. [[1]] [[4]] 

The key trend is that smartphones are becoming a smaller share of TSMC’s mix: the smartphone platform declined from **35% of revenue in 2024 to 29% in 2025**, while HPC increased from **51% to 58%**. [[2]] 

Thus, the best public-data conclusion is: **TSMC’s total smartphone-platform revenue was about US$35.5 billion in 2025, but Apple/iPhone-chip revenue is undisclosed and cannot validly be equated either to the entire smartphone category or to TSMC’s largest-customer revenue.** [[5]] [[1]]
